question: In the review of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles in mixed matrix membranes for wastewater, what tensile strength increase and river-water bacteria removal did the bacterial cellulose acetate membrane with Fe3O4 from pineapple biowaste reach?
rendered: According to the review, the bacterial cellulose acetate-based membrane incorporated with magnetic nanoparticles (Fe3O4) from pineapple biowaste extraction showed an increasing in tensile strength to 73%, and the work has been successful in removing bacteria from river wastewater to 67.4%.
